generate_supernet: generate a neural architecture search supernet with configurable node count and layer types
mask_operation: mask a specific operation in a supernet by setting its value to zero at a given node and input
select_operation: select a specific operation in a supernet by zeroing out all other operations at a given node and input
encode_supernet: encode an uncompressed supernet into a compact integer representation using name compression encoding
decode_supernet: decode a compressed integer supernet representation back into its original connectivity matrix format
